scientific_integrity: All upper bounds are certified by an exhaustive symmetry-reduced maximum-clique computation whose reduction and coloring bound are explicit. The order-five family count and orbit claim are separately replayed by exhaustive clique enumeration and group action. No independent audit, formal proof assistant verification, or expert attestation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is exact only for orders three through six. The order-five classification is under left-right relabeling. The closest source's abstract and metadata were accessible, while section-level full-text comparison was unavailable through the public interface; novelty is therefore best-of-knowledge.
title: Exact small-order even-intersecting permutation families
